evidence: INFERRED from public team histories (base defensive front of the named coordinator's scheme that season) and cross-checked against each roster's own heavy-end share by tests/mod_editor/test_nfl2k5_front_schemes.py; not witnessed in game. A team-season not listed keeps the historic 4-3 rule, which is what every build before b776 gave every historic file.
about: b776-de1 (Noah, 10/18 playtest: Kayvon Thibodeaux at middle linebacker and Leonard Williams at edge on the 22 Giants classic team). The generated rosters label players with retail positions (DE / DT / OLB / ILB). The One-pool build used to turn every one of them with the 4-3 rule (OLB to LB, DE to EDGE), which is wrong for a team-season that ran a 3-4: its pass-rushing outside linebackers became LBs and its heavy ends became EDGE. These lists name the team-seasons that ran a 3-4 so the 3-4 rule applies to them (OLB to EDGE, DE to the interior pool). See nfl2k5_front_schemes.mapping_scheme for when the rule is used (a pure 3-4 stock book keeps the retail slot meaning).

heavy_end_cross_check.about: Cross-check used by the unit test: share of a team's three top-depth DE rows at 280 lb or more. Every listed 3-4 team is at 1/3 or more; every UNLISTED team at 2/3 or more is named here as reviewed and left on the 4-3 rule.
